svg.text: Client1 · C03 extra · Even the right library is hacked if we skip these five
Interview: I can name each lock and what breaks without it.
Right library is not enough — craft all five or it is hacked.
Without a signature anyone can generate a JWT.
HS256 needs 32+ bytes. Six characters will be brute-forced.
HTTP = packet sniff = stolen token. HTTPS is mandatory.

text.tspan: Same as handing over the JWT
TLS encrypts the token in transit

svg.text: Notes said CSS — they mean XSS. Scripts read storage, not httpOnly.
httpOnly cookie still auto-sends. Match antiforgery in JWT + cookie.
